launches.title: Halmos Labs; intelligent experiment design
launches.tagline: Halmos designs experiments for biotech teams
launches.body:
Halmos enables biotech teams to get more out of every experiment. It reads the literature, runs simulations, and selects or trains models to optimize every step — so you extract more information across discovery, process development, scale-up, and manufacturing.\
\
<https://youtu.be/u1ptzxsgzWo>
\
**The problem**\
Experiments are slow, expensive, and most of the information they could yield is wasted. Teams run tedious trial-and-error or exhaustive screens, burning months of lab time and budget to reach conclusions better experimental design would have reached far sooner. The pharmaceutical industry alone performed **$126B of U.S. R&D in 2023**.\
\
**How it works**\
Halmos runs unbounded research by coordinating hundreds of AI agents, checks the logical consistency of their reasoning, and revisits arguments that fail validation before presenting conclusions to your team.\
Zero installations, no data engineering, and no need for your own statistics team.\
\
**Tested in industry:**

* **Bioprocessing:** In a collaboration, Halmos matched the best performance from a company's wet-lab campaign in an average of **30% fewer evaluations** across repeated simulations. Halmos repeatedly recommended testing beyond the permitted range; when the experimentalists eventually explored it, performance improved further.
* **Food-tech fermentation:** For a company two months into fermentation optimization, Halmos simulated the organism's metabolism and identified a nutrient variable missing from the experimental plan. The team confirmed the finding and replanned its next month of experiments.

\
**Towards increasingly large R&D tasks**\
We start by designing experiments. From there we take on increasingly large R&D tasks until we can run full end-to-end programs for biotech teams at a fraction of the cost of a consultant — enabling new discoveries in less well funded industries like food, rare diseases, biomaterials, and agriculture. \
\
**Team**

* **Mattias Akke (CEO)** researched LLM-driven Bayesian optimization at MIT, built drug-discovery models at AstraZeneca, and conducted Alzheimer's research at Cambridge.
* **Linus von Ekensteen Löfgren (CTO)** was a desk quant at Danske Bank, researched LLM security at AI Sweden, and wrote quantum simulation code at Chalmers. Winner of the IEEE AP-S Student Design Contest 2023.
* **Linus Särud (Founding Engineer)** has 12 years of cybersecurity experience and led offensive security at Sciber. He earned bounties for hundreds of vulnerabilities across companies including Google, Meta, Microsoft, and PayPal.

\
**Our ask**\
If you run biotech **R&D, process development, assay development, or manufacturing optimization**, we want to hear from you. **Scope an experiment with us at [halmoslabs.com](http://halmoslabs.com)** or email [**hi@halmoslabs.com**](mailto:hi@halmoslabs.com) (enterprise inquiries welcome).
